Peanut, (Arachis hypogaea), also called groundnut, is an herbaceous annual plant of the pea family (Fabaceae), grown for its edible seeds. The peanut is commonly classified as both a grain legume and, owing to its high oil content, an oil crop. Peanuts grow on sandy soils in warm climates. Being a legume, peanut seeds (peanuts) are rich in protein and essential nutrients. Learn more about peanuts
